tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Keyword search over the Siftivo book catalog. Matches titles, authors, and descriptions. Returns works with the ids other Siftivo tools accept.

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Full detail for one book: synopsis, authors, series position, genres, and its page on siftivo.com. Accepts a work id, an edition id, or a slug.

tools.name: what_to_read_next
tools.description: Given one book, what to read after it: the next books in its series, more by the same author, and books that read like it. This is the same set the book page on siftivo.com shows.

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: An author, their biography, and the works Siftivo holds for them. Accepts an author id or slug.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: A series and its works in reading order. Accepts a series id or slug.

tools.name: get_reading_index
tools.description: The weekly Siftivo Reading Index: the fiction and nonfiction books moving most in cultural circulation this week, ranked.

tools.name: recommend_from_description
tools.description: Describe what someone is in the mood for, in their own words, and get books that match. It suits a theme, subject or feeling ("books about grief", "cozy mysteries set in Cornwall"), and matches on meaning rather than on a title or an author name.

tools.name: recommend_from_titles
tools.description: Give Siftivo a few books someone liked, by title, and get books like them. Titles are resolved against the catalog first; anything that does not resolve is reported back rather than guessed at.

tools.name: get_my_library
tools.description: The signed-in reader's own Siftivo library: what they want to read, are reading, finished, or set down, with their ratings.

tools.name: add_to_library
tools.description: Put a book on one of the signed-in reader's shelves, move it to a different shelf, rate it, or record how far through it they are. The workId is one returned by search_books, get_book or recommend_from_titles. "Finished it, four and a half stars" is one call with readingStatus FINISHED and rating 4.

tools.name: get_my_book
tools.description: Whether the signed-in reader has this book on a shelf, and if so which shelf, their rating and how far through they are. Answers "have I read this?" without pulling the whole library.

tools.name: remove_from_library
tools.description: Take a book off the signed-in reader's shelves entirely, discarding its shelf, progress and notes. The reader's rating for the book stays. This is removal rather than a shelf change: add_to_library with a new readingStatus moves a book between shelves instead.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "add_to_library" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
